**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 19 satisfies (and in one respect exceeds) the preferred WARRANTY position:

- **19.1** — professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards, plus material conformity of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications.
- **19.2** — 90-day Deliverable conformance warranty running from the *later* of delivery or acceptance, and hosted Services must conform **throughout the subscription term** (better than the preferred 12-month software period), plus an authority warranty.
- **19.3** — no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality degradation mid-term, and no open-source contamination of Customer source code.
- **19.4** — full preferred remedy ladder: prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge, then termination of the affected item and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **19.5** — the disclaimer is mutual and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties (the key detection risk here).

Sections 6.1–6.2 add a parallel acceptance correction-and-refund path. Nothing sits at or below the fallback, so no changes are warranted.
